items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Sam Peck come down and got me and said, I want to put music on Ja'Kaula Street. You want to come and work?

ctx.x: When I come back home, I was born around 19-something.

I was working at that oil station and Sam Peck come down and got me and said, I want to put music on Ja'Kaula Street. You want to come and work? I said, yeah, I'd better be waiting around that and be waiting at the oil station. I don't know if that's when I went there. I don't know if that's when I went there. And you was playing at that other place. Yeah. Well, when was that you all went to New York on the boat? When year was it? 1930. 1930. 1930, I remember. Yeah, 1930. Did that trip take long? I forget. 17-day…
They got seasick. They kind of disgust them. They all got their belly.
